questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The dimensional formula of Planck's constant is
questions.explanation: Energy E = h*nu, so h = E/nu = [M L^2 T^-2]/[T^-1] = [M L^2 T^-1].

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The mass of one molecule of water is approximately (N_A = 6.022 x 10^23 mol^-1)
questions.explanation: Mass of one molecule = 18 / (6.022 x 10^23) = 2.99 x 10^-23 g, about 3.0 x 10^-23 g.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Which group of plants is called the 'amphibians of the plant kingdom'?
questions.explanation: Bryophytes need water for the movement of male gametes to the egg, so they are called amphibians of the plant kingdom.

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The natural pacemaker of the human heart is the
questions.explanation: The sino-atrial (SA) node generates the impulses that set the rhythm of the heartbeat, so it acts as the pacemaker.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The number of significant figures in the measured value 0.00250 m is
questions.explanation: Leading zeros are not significant; the trailing zero after 5 is. Hence 2, 5 and the trailing 0 give three significant figures.
